title: Rollout traffic simulator & version-pin UI asset pack for quickstart
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design a set of onboarding-focused UI assets and annotated screenshots demonstrating the rollout composer, version pinning matrix, canary/A-B traffic split editor, and fallback policy editor. These assets will be used in the quickstart walkthrough, docs hero images, and in-app first-run tooltips. Emphasis on clarity for engineers: show intent of traffic percentage sliders, expected latency/cost tradeoffs, and safe rollback flows. Include high-contrast variants and mobile/responsive layouts.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with separate frames for: rollout composer, version pinning matrix, canary editor, A/B split timeline, fallback policy editor, and first-run tooltip set
Annotated PNG/JPEG exports (3x sizes) for docs hero and in-app screenshots
Microcopy snippets for each screen (tooltips, CTAs, error states) in a plain text file
Design reviewed and approved by PM and Eng with accessibility checklist completed
Screenshots added to quickstart PR and linked in the console onboarding modal
comments: 2025-11-10 Maya Chen: Kickoff — aligned with PM on scope. Primary goal is to reduce time-to-first-success for new users configuring rollouts and pins.

2025-11-12 Oliver Patel: Initial wireframes posted to Figma — focused on a single-pane composer with inline traffic preview. Requested an explicit 'safety buffer' UI for canary that shows automatic rollback threshold.

2025-11-13 PM Lina Torres: Reviewed wireframes. Suggested adding a compact matrix for pinning where devs can pin by route or by model version. Also requested sample copy for error conditions when a pinned version is unavailable.
2025-11-15 Maya Chen: High-fidelity mocks uploaded (Figma link in attachments). Created high-contrast color variants and responsive layouts (desktop, tablet, narrow).

2025-11-16 Oliver Patel: Engineering review — flagged a potential complexity in the A/B split timeline animation; recommended static step indicators for first-run assets. Added suggestion to include token cost delta badge in the traffic preview.

2025-11-18 Accessibility review (Leah Brooks): Contrast checks passed; suggested increased hit area for small traffic sliders and keyboard-only navigation states. Added aria-label suggestions for tooltip triggers.
2025-11-19 Maya Chen: Updated microcopy per accessibility feedback and PM notes. Exported screenshots in required sizes and uploaded to Drive. Preparing PR for quickstart changes.

2025-11-20 Oliver Patel: In Review — confirming image export checklist and linking screenshots in quickstart doc. Noted one follow-up: create a variant showing a stuck canary and the recommended fallback action sequence for the incident playbook.
attachments: Incident playbook example referencing fallback flow: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ROLL-PLAYBOOK
